method: fresh interpreter per sample; opposing lane order in alternating rounds; same deterministic ASCII arrays; source reading, SHA256 and complete field aggregation inside timing; GC enabled; fixture creation and source receipts outside timing; optional tracing in separate workers
limitations: synthetic event records on one host; OS file cache is uncontrolled; RSS includes interpreter and backend imports; first-item source bytes measure the raw source API, not physical disk traffic; timing includes aggregation and hashing and is not an isolated decoder throughput claim; memory depends on the largest individual item and configured chunk size

publication_metadata_normalization.note: Consumer and machine-specific origin labels normalized for public publication; numerical evidence and captured source hashes retained.
